## IVirtualFileSystem interface

A virtual filesystem interface that abstracts file operations. All paths should be absolute and use forward slashes.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface IVirtualFileSystem 
```

## Remarks

This interface allows for multiple implementations (in-memory, real filesystem, etc.) and facilitates testing without touching the actual filesystem.
